## SquirrelDisk 2.6.1 (fork 1)

Based on SquirrelDisk 2.6.1.

- **No ads, no tracking.** The sponsor system and its hourly check-in are gone.
- **No silent updates.** The app no longer downloads and installs updates from upstream.
- **A native look.** Uses the system font and follows the system's light or dark appearance. It has a single accent color and far fewer cards, badges and labels. The duplicate finder in particular is much simpler.
- **Separate from upstream.** It keeps its own settings, so it can sit next to the original app without either one changing the other.

Apple Silicon only.
